label.zh: 第二阶段：按战利品只发生一种

note.zh: 阶段2开始时游戏同时触发11个事件，但每个事件都检查 celebration_* 标记（由开启庆典的击败事件设置），所以只会出现与战利品对应的那一个。
note.en: Entering stage 2 fires all eleven events at once, but each checks a celebration_* flag set by the victory event that started the parade, so only the matching one appears.

note.zh: 1000 要求拥有者是格式塔；1005 要求不是。两者各有三个按奖励等级（小/标准/大）出现的选项。
note.en: 1000 needs a gestalt owner, 1005 a non-gestalt owner; each has three options shown by reward tier (small/standard/large).

note.zh: 移除污染修正，并为同一庆典增加一级单位奖励。
note.en: Removes the contaminant modifier and raises the celebration reward one tier.

label.zh: 行星化为黑洞或趋于稳定
label.en: Planet becomes a black hole or stabilises

note.zh: 约2:1 随机（在 1090 选择时即已掷出）。
note.en: About 2:1 random, rolled when 1090 is answered (situation_events.txt:5017-5020).

notes.zh: 审阅注：击败巨兽后由 16 个事件分别 start_situation 开启（见 callers）：以太龙 670、噬星者 1016、幽魂 2014、神秘堡垒 2099/2151/2154/2156、位面之魇 3003、无畏战舰 3102、拾荒机器人/提央奇/天空龙/孳孽/碎片/古老者/巨虫来自其他DLC。每月进度基础+4（鼓励+2，抑制-8，重组暂停并花费1000凝聚力）；进度50/70/100进入阶段2/3/完成；若目标星球易主则中止（01_narrative_situations.txt:470-622）。
notes.en: Review note: started by start_situation from 16 victory events (see callers): Ether Drake 670, Stellar Devourer 1016, Wraith 2014, Fortress 2099/2151/2154/2156, Horror 3003, Dreadnought 3102 and other-DLC kills (Scavenger Bot, Tiyanki, Sky Dragon, Voidspawn, Shard, Elder One, worm). Monthly progress base +4 (+2 encourage, -8 discourage; reorganize freezes it for 1000 unity); stages at 50/70/100; aborted if the target planet changes owner (01_narrative_situations.txt:470-622).

notes.zh: 审阅注：仅恐怖负相物质类战利品（位面之魇、古老者、巨虫）会走到这里：完成时 set_celebration_modifier 依 1080 所设标记给星球加修正并延迟 2480 天（“控制”则 4960 天）触发 1085 → 1240 天 → 1090 → 720 天 → 1095（00_scripted_effects.txt:5897-5983）。
notes.en: Review note: only the Horrific Inverse Mass trophies (dimensional horror, Elder One, worm) reach this: on completion set_celebration_modifier adds a planet modifier and fires 1085 after 2480 days (4960 if contained), then 1090 after 1240 and 1095 after 720 (00_scripted_effects.txt:5897-5983).

notes.zh: 审阅注：选项 a 开启污染情境（situation_tainted_voidspawn）；该情境运行时庆典进度为 0（01_narrative_situations.txt:598-609）。
notes.en: Review note: option a starts the contamination situation; while it runs the celebration progress is frozen (01_narrative_situations.txt:598-609).

scope.zh: 完整：情境定义、阶段2十一事件的互斥、完成事件、位面之魇后续与失败/开始的隐藏事件。
scope.en: Complete: situation definition, stage-2 exclusivity, completion events, horror follow-up, hidden start/fail events.

uncertain: The Chinese names of Shard/Tiyanki/Dreadnought trophies in the stage labels are descriptive; check against the reader text.
